name: singlet_programs_denovo_program_decomposition
title: De novo gene program decomposition
description: Fits K non-negative gene programs to variable-gene counts and returns per-cell usages, L1-normalised program loadings and a per-program stability table. The default method schpf is a Gamma-Poisson model fitted by variational inference; cnmf and fasttopics are comparators. K is required, usually chosen with programs.program_number_selection. To project new cells onto fixed programs, use programs.program_usage_estimation instead.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Count layer to read; the variable-gene mask is read from var/highly_variable.

k.description: Number of programs K. Required; choose it with programs.program_number_selection.

method.description: Decomposition method. schpf is the model-based default; cnmf is the consensus comparator.

n_restarts.description: Independent random starts; stability is computed across starts. cNMF calls this n_iter.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for the random starts; reproducible on the same backend.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

cnmf.description: Options for method cnmf; the call is refused for other methods.

local_density_threshold.description: Density threshold tau; replicates at or above it are discarded before clustering.

local_neighborhood_size.description: Fraction of starts used as nearest neighbours for local density.

max_nmf_iter.description: Maximum iterations per Frobenius NMF start.

schpf.description: Options for method schpf; the call is refused for other methods.

a.description: Shape of the Gamma prior on usages.

c.description: Shape of the Gamma prior on loadings.

epsilon.description: Relative change in loss below which a start counts as converged.

fasttopics.description: Options for method fasttopics (Poisson NMF); the call is refused for other methods.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: fitted and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obsm/program_usage. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed fits: method, k, n_restarts, n_cells, n_genes, median_program_stability, programs_stable, zero_usage_cells, and outlier_fraction for cnmf.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
